The Farmers' Market in Brazos County

Saturday, November 7, 2026
8:00 AM – 12:00 PM

  • Admission: Free
Website

Located in Midtown Park, The Farmers' Market in Brazos County is a venue where local farmers can connect directly with Brazos Valley consumers, to build a community in an urban setting, and to provide public education on regional farming, gardening and food preparation.
